task.title: Normalize governed progress from real activity event shapes

scope.owned_layer: Pure immutable normalization of governed ai-status reviewer reopen and worker-commit activity over the merged V3 failure record.
scope.not_changing: Failure recording, retry eligibility, recovery consumption, canonical task state, queues, workers, leases, reservations, provider state, configuration, product controllers, and live services.

contract.failure_input: Exact V3 streak decoded by decode_task_failure_streak; the latest immutable generation is the only failure generation bound by one normalized event.
contract.baseline: A lowercase 40-hex rejected_head is required; ABSENT and malformed baselines fail closed.
contract.identity: The failure provider must equal normalize_agent_id(owner_at_failure), owner and reviewer must differ, and event task_id/actor must match exactly without aliases.
contract.reviewer_reopen: Requires type=reopen, exact reviewer actor, a recomputed ai-status-event SHA-256 identity, a timestamp strictly after failure, and a production review bridge that matches actor/decision/time/rejected head when present.
contract.worker_commit: Requires type=worker_commit, exact owner actor, lowercase 40-hex commit, event_id exactly worker-commit-<commit>, and commit different from rejected_head.
contract.handoff: Rejected: production ai-status handoff is owner-to-reviewer and is not independent reviewer progress.
contract.output: A scalar-only MappingProxyType carrying schema version, stable sha256 generation id, failure generation id, task/provider, event id/type/time/actor, and exact head or ABSENT.
contract.purity: The normalizer performs no writes or mutation of the streak, event, canonical task state, runtime state, or provider state.

deny_matrix: missing task_id, agent, event_id, timestamp, or commit
uppercase or malformed head and mismatched worker-commit identity
review bridge off the rejected-head lineage
generic note/progress/last_update, dispatch sync, wake, worker start, test rerun, or PR bind
owner-to-reviewer handoff of the same head
missing owner record or owner equal to reviewer

verification.result: checkout-scoped .venv-pantheon provisioned and dependency imports verified

verification.command: git merge-base --is-ancestor <each rejected PR #4442 head> HEAD

review.note: Owner-authored evidence only. Independent exact-head review is required before approval or merge.
